description: IAM User Has Active Persistent Access Key — Review
rationale: An IAM user has an active long-lived access key regardless of age. This is an inventory and rotation/federation review recommendation, not proof that the credential has been exposed or violates policy. SES SMTP may require an exception.
remediation: Use OIDC/STS and service roles where possible; for unavoidable static keys document exception, least privilege, rotation, monitoring and owner.
